parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with geographical details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for the map and rotates around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis within the supporting frame.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, usually made of wood or metal, providing structural support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the rotating sphere and keeps the globe upright on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
